audience.text: Java developers building or inspecting 3D scenes who need a free, MIT-licensed library with API compatibility to Aspose.3D for Java.

capabilities.text: Build and traverse 3D scene graphs using Scene, Node, Entity, and Group classes with parent-child hierarchy support.
capabilities.title: Scene graph construction

capabilities.text: Import and export STL geometry (binary or ASCII) using StlLoadOptions and StlSaveOptions dispatched through Scene.fromFile and Scene.save.
capabilities.title: Format I/O for STL

capabilities.text: Detect file format automatically or resolve it explicitly from file path or binary stream using FileFormat.detect and FileFormat.getFormatByExtension.
capabilities.title: Format detection

capabilities.text: Generate ready-to-use geometry for Box, Cylinder, Sphere, and Dish primitives via their toMesh() method.
capabilities.title: Primitive geometry generation

capabilities.text: Define materials including albedo, metallic/roughness, occlusion, and emissive channels with texture references using PbrMaterial and other material types.
capabilities.title: Material definition

capabilities.text: Model NURBS curves by exposing control points, knot vectors, degree, and order data through NurbsCurve.
capabilities.title: NURBS curve data modeling

capabilities.text: Perform geometry and transform math using Vector2/3/4, Matrix4, Quaternion, and BoundingBox classes.
capabilities.title: Math utilities

limitations.text: STL is the only format with fully functional import and export in the published 26.5.0 package; other formats have stub implementations.
OBJ import is not functional in the published artifact despite having a parser in upstream source; it ships as a stub.
NURBS curve sampling is not implemented; only control-point/knot/degree data is exposed.
PbrSpecularMaterial accessors are unimplemented; PbrMaterial is the functional alternative.
Scene rendering is not implemented in this edition.

problems_solved.text: Provides a free, open-source alternative to the commercial Aspose.3D for Java library for basic 3D scene graph operations and STL format I/O.
Enables automatic format detection and explicit format resolution for supported 3D file types via FileFormat APIs.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Java is a clean-room, open-source implementation of a 3D scene graph API for Java, exposing the same com.aspose.threed.* package as the commercial library.

uncertainties: The README mentions OBJ import has a working parser upstream but the published artifact ships a stub; it is unclear whether OBJ export is functional.
It is unclear whether glTF import/export is functional beyond option handling, as FILE_FORMATS.md and the summary table reportedly disagree.
The exact set of primitives with unimplemented toMesh() beyond NURBS is not fully specified in the facts.
It is unclear whether texture loading and saving beyond raw bytes is supported.
The behavior of formats that 'fail silently' is not detailed beyond general warnings.
It is unclear whether the public API surface beyond com.aspose.threed.* is fully exposed.
The relationship between the FOSS package and the commercial Enterprise Edition beyond API compatibility is not detailed in the facts.
It is unclear whether the test suite covers all format I/O paths beyond STL and glTF options.

workflows.name: Load and convert 3D files
workflows.text: Load a 3D file using Scene.fromFile and save it in another format using Scene.save, with automatic format detection or explicit format specification.

workflows.name: Build scene graphs from primitives
workflows.text: Construct a scene graph using Scene, Node, and Entity, and attach geometry from primitives like Box, Cylinder, Sphere, and Dish via toMesh().

workflows.name: Assign materials to nodes
workflows.text: Define materials such as LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, and PbrMaterial and assign them to nodes using Node.setMaterial.
